title: UIL Competition Travel Fee: Business Office Computation for 2026-27, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Competition travel fee.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the travel fee of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is the scheduled travel fee: the UIL Academic and Robotics Team travel fee of the activity fee catalogue, rounded to the cent. A travel fee that works out to 0.00 posts nothing.

**The team's trips.** The team's competition trips for the 2026-27 school year fall on these dates:

| Activity | Competition trips of the 2026-27 school year |
|---|---|
| robotics | 2026-10-17, 2026-12-05, 2027-02-20, 2027-04-17 |
| one-act play | 2026-10-24, 2026-12-12, 2027-03-20, 2027-04-24 |
| any other activity of the type (UIL academics) | 2026-11-07, 2027-01-30, 2027-03-27, 2027-04-24 |

**Order of assembly.** The travel fee is assembled in this order: amounts are added together first, the shares are then applied one after the other to that total, never below 0.00, any further amount is added after the shares, and the result is rounded once, at the end, to the nearest cent with half a cent rounding up.

## The order on hypothetical figures

| Stage | Hypothetical figures | Running figure |
|---|---|---|
| amounts added together | 88.00 and minus 12.50 | 75.50 |
| never below 0.00 | | 75.50 |
| a first share of 110 percent | 75.50 multiplied by 1.10 | 83.05 |
| a second share of 40 percent, on that figure | 83.05 multiplied by 0.40 | 33.22 |
| a further amount added after the shares | plus 7.00 | 40.22 |
| rounded once, half a cent up | | 40.22 |

A further amount added after the shares is not multiplied by any share. A result of 0.00 posts no travel fee.
